title: Kestrel Care Rewards Earning Terms — Front-Store, Store-Brand and Bonus Points
content:
Members of **Kestrel Care Rewards** earn points on front-store shopping, on Kestrel store-brand items, as a welcome bonus when the membership opens and as a birthday bonus. The rates depend on the membership level.

## Earning terms

1. **When points can be earned.** Points are earned only while the membership is enrolled or active; the welcome bonus posts on enrollment. A suspended or closed membership earns no points.
2. **Welcome bonus.** The welcome bonus is the level's welcome-bonus amount, credited once when the membership opens at a level where that amount is above 0.
3. **Front-store and store-brand spend.** Front-store spend earns the level's front-store rate for each whole dollar of eligible spend, and Kestrel store-brand spend earns the level's store-brand rate for each whole dollar. The points so found are multiplied by the points multiplier, which is 2 on one of the level's double-points promotional days of the calendar year and 1 on any other day. No more than the level's daily front-store cap is earned in one calendar day. The points post the level's pending period in days after the purchase.
4. **Birthday bonus.** The birthday bonus of the level's birthday amount posts once a year, in the patient's birth month.
5. **Once per occasion.** An occasion earns points once.

## Benefits chart by level

| | Member | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Plus Monthly | Plus Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Welcome bonus (points) | 500 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Front-store rate (points per whole dollar) | 10 | 12 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Store-brand rate (points per whole dollar) | 20 | 24 | 30 | 40 | 40 | 40 |
| Daily front-store cap (points per calendar day) | 5000 | 6000 | 7500 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 |
| Pending period before points post (calendar days) | 14 | 14 | 14 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Double-points promotional days per calendar year | 4 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 12 | 12 |
| Birthday bonus (points) | 0 | 500 | 1000 | 2000 | 1000 | 1000 |

Column headings are the Kestrel Care Rewards levels: Kestrel Care Rewards Member, Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum, Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly and Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual.

## How a purchase's points are found

The points on a purchase are the whole dollars of eligible spend, multiplied by the level's rate for that kind of spend, multiplied by the points multiplier of the purchase day, and the day's front-store points never exceed the daily cap.

**Hypothetical examples** (the purchase amounts and dates are illustrations; the rates are the chart above):

| Level | Purchase | Day | Points found | Points credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gold | 36.00 of eligible front-store spend | ordinary day | 36 whole dollars multiplied by 15, multiplied by 1: 540 | 540 |
| Gold | 36.00 of eligible front-store spend | double-points day | 36 multiplied by 15, multiplied by 2: 1080 | 1080 |
| Platinum | 12.00 of store-brand spend | ordinary day | 12 multiplied by 40, multiplied by 1: 480 | 480 |
| Member | 300.00 of eligible front-store spend, the only purchase that day | double-points day | 300 multiplied by 10, multiplied by 2: 6000 | 5000 (daily cap) |

*Posting date.* The Platinum purchase above, made on 3 June, posts its points 7 days later, on 10 June. The same purchase at Kestrel Care Rewards Silver would post 14 days later, on 17 June.

## Points of judgement

- **Membership status on the purchase.** Suspended — no points. Closed — no points. Enrolled or active — points under the terms above.
- **Welcome bonus.** A membership opened at Kestrel Care Rewards Member receives 500 points once; one opened at a Plus level receives 1000 points once.
- **Birthday bonus at Kestrel Care Rewards Member.** The birthday amount at that level is 0 points.
- **The same purchase presented again.** An occasion earns points once; a purchase that has already earned points does not earn them a second time.
